name: ntr_db_admin_mapping_main
xsql:
SELECT * FROM $framework.NATERA_MAPPING_MAIN 
WHERE :v_search_main IS NULL 
   OR :v_search_main = ''
   OR lower(category) LIKE lower('%' || :v_search_main || '%')
   OR lower(sub_category) LIKE lower('%' || :v_search_main || '%')
   OR lower(identifier) LIKE lower('%' || :v_search_main || '%');
